WITH cov AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    AND pcd.Effective_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
    AND pcd.Effective_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
),
prem AS (
  SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
  JOIN cov ON pa.Effective_Date = cov.Effective_Date

  WHERE pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."premium"
  )
),

  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" cc
  JOIN cov ON cc.Effective_Date = cov.Effective_Date

),

WITH term_premium AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    pa.Effective_Date,
    pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,

  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Policy_Identifier,
    Effective_Date,
    term_premium,
    AVG(term_premium) OVER (PARTITION BY Policy_Identifier) AS avg_premium_per_term,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Policy_Identifier ORDER BY Effective_Date DESC, Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier DESC) AS rn
  FROM term_premium
)
SELECT
  po.Policy_Identifier,
  po.Policy_Number,
  r.avg_premium_per_term,
  r.term_premium AS latest_term_premium,
  r.term_premium - r.avg_premium_per_term AS latest_minus_avg
FROM ranked r
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" po
  ON po.Policy_Identifier = r.Policy_Identifier
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY po.Policy_Number, po.Policy_Identifier
